LanguageData.BOR_Associate.label: associate
LanguageData.BOR_Associate.description: An associate of the Kwazaari is a honorable position which mainly serves as the gateway to trade with the Kwazaari.
LanguageData.BOR_BranchManager.label: branch manager
LanguageData.BOR_BranchManager.description: A branch manager is the kwazaari equivalent of a governor. They command and help in the day-to-day activities of a colony - what they call "a branch".
LanguageData.BOR_Candidate.label: candidate
LanguageData.BOR_Candidate.description: A candidate for the position of an intern.
LanguageData.BOR_Intern.label: intern
LanguageData.BOR_Intern.description: A kwazaari intern, not yet an employee, but not a stranger anymore.
LanguageData.BOR_Junior.label: junior trader
LanguageData.BOR_Junior.description: Recently-onboarded trader with some perks, but few expectations.
LanguageData.BOR_Senior.label: senior trader
LanguageData.BOR_Senior.description: A senior trader is defined by the kwazaari as a trader who defines the tradee and the trade on their own and can fulfil it.
LanguageData.BOR_TeamLeader.label: team leader
LanguageData.BOR_TeamLeader.description: A team leader is a lower administrative position, which governs over multiple kwazaari households.
